WITH
OPT AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_ID, PRICE, NORMAL_PRICE, QUANTITY, OPT_STOCK FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_ID, PRICE, NORMAL_PRICE, QUANTITY, SUM(NVL(QUANTITY,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO) AS OPT_STOCK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY OPTION_ID) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_OPTION
WHERE CASE WHEN OPTION1_TYPE = '색상' THEN OPTION1_VALUE WHEN OPTION2_TYPE = '색상' THEN OPTION2_VALUE WHEN OPTION3_TYPE = '색상' THEN OPTION3_VALUE END IN #{c}
) WHERE RN = 1 ),
RV AS ( SELECT od.PRODUCT_NO, ROUND(AVG(r.PRODUCT_RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW r JOIN ORDER_DETAIL od ON r.ORDER_DETAIL_NO = od.ORDER_DETAIL_NO GROUP BY od.PRODUCT_NO ),
IMG AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_ID, IMAGE_URL FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_ID, IMAGE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_ID ORDER BY IMAGE_ORDER) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IMAGE_PURPOSE = '대표' ) WHERE RN = 1 ),
IMG_ANY AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY OPTION_ID, IMAGE_ORDER) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IMAGE_PURPOSE = '대표' ) WHERE RN = 1 ),
SC AS ( SELECT od.PRODUCT_NO, SUM(od.ORDER_QTY) AS SALE_COUNT FROM ORDER_DETAIL od JOIN ORDERS o ON od.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS != '주문취소' GROUP BY od.PRODUCT_NO ),
OC AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, COUNT(*) AS OPTION_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_OPTION GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO )
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_NAME, PARENT_CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_LEVEL FROM CATEGORY WHERE PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo} ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO
SELECT CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_NAME, PARENT_CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_LEVEL FROM CATEGORY START WITH CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = CATEGORY_NO ORDER BY CATEGORY_LEVEL

SELECT SIB.CATEGORY_NO, SIB.CATEGORY_NAME, SIB.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO, SIB.CATEGORY_LEVEL FROM CATEGORY SELF JOIN CATEGORY SIB ON (SIB.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = SELF.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO OR (SIB.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO IS NULL AND SELF.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO IS NULL)) WHERE SELF.CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo} ORDER BY SIB.CATEGORY_NO

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN PO.OPTION1_TYPE = '색상' THEN PO.OPTION1_VALUE WHEN PO.OPTION2_TYPE = '색상' THEN PO.OPTION2_VALUE WHEN PO.OPTION3_TYPE = '색상' THEN PO.OPTION3_VALUE END AS OPTION_VALUE FROM PRODUCT_OPTION PO JOIN PRODUCT P ON PO.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE
AND '색상' IN (PO.OPTION1_TYPE, PO.OPTION2_TYPE, PO.OPTION3_TYPE) ORDER BY OPTION_VALUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN OPT ON OPT.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN RV ON RV.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OPT.OPTION_ID, NVL(IMG.IMAGE_URL, IMG_ANY.IMAGE_URL) AS THUMBNAIL_URL, NVL(P.PRODUCT_PRICE, 0) + NVL(OPT.PRICE, 0) AS SALE_PRICE, CASE WHEN OPT.NORMAL_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(P.PRODUCT_PRICE, 0) + OPT.NORMAL_PRICE END AS NORMAL_PRICE,
CASE WHEN P.SALE_STATUS = '품절' OR NVL(OPT.OPT_STOCK, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SOLD_OUT,
CASE WHEN P.SALE_STATUS = '품절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SOLD_OUT,
NVL(RV.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING, NVL(RV.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT, NVL(SC.SALE_COUNT, 0) AS SALE_COUNT FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN OPT ON OPT.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN IMG ON IMG.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND IMG.OPTION_ID = OPT.OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN IMG_ANY ON IMG_ANY.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN RV ON RV.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN SC ON SC.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN OC ON OC.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
ORDER BY
NVL(P.PRODUCT_PRICE, 0) + NVL(OPT.PRICE, 0) ASC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC NVL(P.PRODUCT_PRICE, 0) + NVL(OPT.PRICE, 0) DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC NVL(SC.SALE_COUNT, 0) DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC
NVL(SC.SALE_COUNT, 0) DESC, NVL(RV.AVG_RATING, 0) DESC, NVL(RV.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) DESC, NVL(OC.OPTION_COUNT, 0) DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC
P.CREATED_DATE DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{listSize} ROWS ONLY
